system.description:
Most spirits will not speak the tongues of the living, whether from inability or sheer refusal. Astral Cant opens the thaumaturge's ears and mouth to their own strange languages.

Spend a Willpower Trait to activate the power for the remainder of the scene. While it is active you may converse with spirits in their own languages and understand everything they say in return. Beware that this path forces spirits into unnatural behavior, so whenever you lose a challenge while working with a spirit you must make a Simple Test, and on a loss the spirit turns its wrath upon you. Retest with Occult.
